__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a very rough and overgrown path heading east-west over rugged
terrain.  To the east the path passes between low hills.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road heads into low hills this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1601 to 1602

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The cross-roads and a trading post lie in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1601 to 1702

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Rough East-West Path

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here the path passes between low hills. The going is very rough, but
to the east the ground is smoother. In that direction a pair of tower
looms above the hills.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a pair of tall towers in the distance.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1602 to 1603

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1602 to 1601

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Rough Path Between the Hills

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a path through an open area. East of here loom two tall towers,
joined by a barbican and surrounded by a murky moat. West the path passes
between low hills.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Two fantastic towers surrounded by a moat rise before you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1603 to 1604

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The road continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1603 to 1602

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Path through an Open Area

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand on the west side of a moat that encircles two towers, each
over 50 feet high. You will need a boat to go east across the moat. A
rugged path heads west, and another one heads north to a cluster of low
buildings.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A worn path leads to a cluster of low buildings.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1604 to 1605

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The Towers loom directly over you, just beyond the moat.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1604 to 1620

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An old ill-kept roads leads away to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1604 to 1603

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: West Side of Moat

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You walk on a faint path heading south toward the west side of the moat,
and north to three small buildings.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Several low buildings lie this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1605 to 1606

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The path ends west of the moat.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1605 to 1604

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Path North of Moat

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the middle of a cluster of small buildings. There is a building
to the north, east, and west.  A sign over the eastern building says
'House of Pancakes'.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is an entrance to a building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1606 to 1609

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A sign over the door reads 'House of Pancakes'.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1606 to 1607

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A path heads south toward the west side of the towers.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1606 to 1605

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is an entrance to a building here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1606 to 1608

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Cluster of Buildings

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The moment you enter this room, the ceiling descends and crushes you
into a pancake.  Don't you hate it when that happens?
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: House of Pancakes

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered what appears to be an old storeroom. Most of the items
that were in here appear to have been ruined long ago.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Old Store Room

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This room appears to be completely empty. The only exit seems to be the
way you came.  There are some scratches around the floor.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a concealed opening leading down.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1609 to 1610

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Empty Room

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered a secret chamber under the empty room. In this room is
the worn but cared-for gear and trappings of some large humanoid.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Minotaur's Room

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the middle of the moat, on the west side of the tower.  There is a
landing on both sides of the moat.  Deep throated 'ribbids' come from the
water all around you.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Western Moat

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the middle of the moat, on the north side of the tower.  There is
no place to land here.  Deep throated 'ribbids' come from the water all
around you.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Northern Moat

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the middle of the moat, on the south side of the tower.  There is
no place to land here.  Deep throated 'ribbids' come from the water all
around you.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Southern Moat

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a foyer on the west side of the structure. The moat is west of
here. There is also a large door eastward into the structure.  You notice that
the walls are ornately decorated with very life-like stone gargoyles.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Tower Foyer

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered a vast lobby. This lobby appears to have once been very
ornately furnished, but now everything is decayed and moldering.  A highly
ornate balcony surrounds the lobby. To the east, below the balcony, is an
opening. The door leading out is west.  You notice that the balcony is
covered in highly ornate and life-like stone gargoyles.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Grand Lobby

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the center of the Western tower's base. Torch brackets occupy
the four corners of this huge room. Above each torch is a lifelike ornate
stone gargoyle.  There are doors north and south, and passages east and west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Base of the Western Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are walking along a musty east-west corridor joining the two towers.
There are room on each side of the corridor, and openings at each end.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Musty Corridor

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered what must once have been a kitchen. The rusting remains of
various utensils lie on countertops. There is also an old wash basin and a
pot-belly stove.  There is a door south, and a serving hatch east.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Kitchen

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the tower's private conservatory. However, through years of neglect,
the plants have grown into a hideous jungle.  The only exit is north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Conservatory

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered a fabulous dining hall.  The wrecked remains of a long table
dominate the room. A horrible odor pervades the room, like some foul-smelling
beast has been eating and shitting in here.  There is a serving hatch west and
a door south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Dining Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the ruined remains of an art gallery. Everything appears to
have been stolen long ago, however.  The only exit is north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Art Gallery

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the center of the Eastern tower's base. Torch brackets occupy the
four corners of this huge room.  Above each torch is a lifelike ornate stone
gargoyle.  There are are open doors to the north and south, and passages east
and west.  In addition, a spiral staircase leads up to the next level of this
tower.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a spiral staircase leading up.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1631 to 1635

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Base of the Eastern Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in what must once have been a common room for all residents of the
tower. There is a huge fire pit with a chimney in the center, and the smashed
remains of a great many table and chairs.  The exit is south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You notice a grate in the bottom of the fire pit.  Maybe it's an opening ...
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1632 to 1634

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Common Room

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in what once was the servant's quarters, as evidenced by the shabby
belongings and decor. What little remains is rotting and of little value
anyway.  The only exit is north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Servant's Quarters

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a large, murky cellar. An almost tangible air of horror pervades
the room.  A thin layer of nitre covers the walls and ceiling.  Rotting
furniture looms obliquely about the room.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Large Murky Cellar

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a Spiral staircase connecting the first and second levels of
the eastern tower. You can go up or down.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the First Staircase

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the center of the second level of the Eastern tower. This large
room appears quite empty, except for the candle abras firmly fixed to the
walls.  An opening leads westward, and a spiral staircase leads down.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Second Level of the Eastern Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in what was once a elegant hall, although everything is moldering now.
The rotted remains of a plush carpet covers the floor, while several moldy
tapestries adorn the each side of the hall.  There are door north and south,
and openings east and west.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Elegant Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered an elegantly furnished room that looks to be still in use!
Costly paintings and pieces of furniture are tastefully situated.  On the
north wall is an altar to Knar, the ghastly patron of Gargoyles.  The only
exit is south.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Shaman's Room

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This room appears to have been a library.  Empty book shelves line each wall.
The only exit is north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Library

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the center of the western tower's second floor.  A large spiral
staircase of 29 steps connects this level with the third.  There are doors
to the east and west.  Except for a torch bracket in each corner, the
room is barren.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the spiral staircase leading up.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1640 to 1642

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Second Level of the Western Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on the balcony overlooking the Grand lobby.  You have a fabulous
view of the entire room.  The only exit is the way you came in.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Balcony

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a large spiral staircase of 29 steps, leading between the
second and third floors.  You can go up or down.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Spiral Stairs

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the center of the western tower's third floor.  This large room
glows mysteriously with a strange light all its own.  From a door to the east
comes a strange inky blackness.  A spiral staircase leads down.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Third Level of Western Tower
It's too dark to see anything!

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
In this room, which has somehow evaded the ravages of time, are neatly stored
racks of common weapons.  They appear to be quite ordinary; however, a chest
in one corner catches your eye.  The only exit is the way you came in.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Armory

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have entered a lavish but functional room decked out in a military style.
Murals on the wall show battle scenes in gargoyles, minotaurs, and huge,
flying snake-like reptiles with poisonous tails fight humans and dwarves.
Various objects in the room give evidence that it is occupied by individuals
of authority.  The only door is north.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Officer's Quarters

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the center of the Eastern Tower's third floor.  The room you are in
glows with a mysterious light that has no source.  In the center of the room a
ladder climbs up to a hatchway in the ceiling.  The hatchway is a strange
looking keyhole.  There is also a door to the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The hatchway appears securely fastened.  In it is a strange keyhole.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1647 to 1648

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Third Level of Eastern Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand in the turret of the eastern tower.  A huge hole has been
made in the roof by some enormous beast, letting the daylight (or moonlight)
in.  There is a hatchway in the floor, and an opening to the west leading out
onto a catwalk.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a small opening this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1648 to 1649

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Turret of the Eastern Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are outdoors on a catwalk between the turrets of the eastern and
western towers.  There is a 40 foot drop to the north and south.  You have
a fabulous view of the surrounding countryside, which consists of a bleak
wilderness.  At the east end of the catwalk is a small opening leading
inside the eastern turret.  At the western end, a strange mirror-like portal
leads into the western turret.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A mirror-like portal glimmers, allowing entry into the western turret.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1649 to 1650

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Catwalk

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the turret of the western tower.  You feel very strange here.
Scattered about this room are a great many coins and valuable articles.
Yet you can't get rid of a feeling of dread!  A mirror-like portal is in the
western wall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A mirror-like portal glimmers in this wall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1650 to 1651

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Turret of the Western Tower

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are outdoors on a catwalk between the turrets of the Eastern and Western
towers.  There is no opening into the western tower of any kind.  You have a
fabulous view of your surroundings, a murky city partially obscured by strange
smoke that creeps along the ground instead of rising. The city stretches as far
as the eye can see under the conditions.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: On the Other Side

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a small carpeted chamber. The chamber is empty except for a single
chair facing a mirror on the wall.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Chamber

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on the old Eastern Road.  The crossroads to the east joins ANOTHER
northern route to this road, which continues east.  South of the crossroads is
an old building.  The area around here is lightly timbered.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a cross roads and an old building.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1701 to 1702

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Main Eastern Road

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at a crossroads to the wilderness areas east and north of here,
and the more civilized areas to the west. The main road is west, an
older road continues east, and a simple trail heads north.  To the south,
an old ram-shackle building is being used as a trading post for the
surrounding wilderness.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a trail leading north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1702 to 1704

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The old Eastern road continues this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1702 to 1601

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: An old, ram-shackle building serves as a trading post here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1702 to 1703

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Crossroads to the Wilderness

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a trading post just south of the crossroads, where rangers,
trappers and hunters from the surrounding area come to buy, sell, and
barter goods.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The door opens out on the crossroads.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1703 to 1702

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Trading Post

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a primitive north-south trail. South of here is a major cross-
roads and an old building. To the north the trail continues toward a
deep, dark forest.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail continues toward a deep, dark, forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1704 to 1705

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A major crossroads and a building lie in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1704 to 1702

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Trail north of crossroads

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a primitive north-south trail.  Just north of here looms the
entrance to a deep, dark forest. To the south the trail continues.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail enters a dark forest of thick oaks this way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1705 to 1706

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The trail continues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1705 to 1704

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Trail south of forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at the entrance to dark forest comprised mostly of huge black oak
and towering firs.  A trail from the south continues north on into the
woods at this point.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the trail continuing into the forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1706 to 1707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the trail head back on south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1706 to 1705

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Entrance to the forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The trail here passes through groves of closely knit Black Oak. Some of
these trees are of enormous size.  Rustling and other low noises come
from the forest on either side of the trail.  The trail continues on north
and south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the trail continue into thick, dark forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1707 to 1708

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The edge of the forest is visible in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1707 to 1706

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Trail in Dark Oak Forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the midst of a deep dark forest of huge oak trees.  There is a
junction of trails here, with paths leading south, west and east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A path disappears into thick forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1708 to 1720

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A path disappears into thick forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1708 to 1707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the path to the Centaur village.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1708 to 1709

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Junction in Dark Forest

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on an east-west path in the forest.  Here the forest is mostly
towering firs, not quite as dense as the oak groves that can be seen eastward.
Westward, the trail heads toward a small clearing.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A path disappears into thick forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1709 to 1708

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a small clearing in this direction.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1709 to 1710

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Path to Centaur Village

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on the east side of a clearing.  Small primitive huts are scattered
about the edges of this clearing.  Beyond these on all sides are towering
fir trees.  A path leads east out of the clearing. The clearing continues to
the west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a hut here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1710 to 1712

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A path leads away through the forest.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1710 to 1709

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a hut here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1710 to 1713

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the west side of the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1710 to 1711

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The East side of the Centaur Clearing

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on the west side of the clearing in the center of the Centaur village.
Huts surround the clearing on all sides, and beyond are towering firs.  The
clearing continues to the east.  To the west is a very large hut.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a hut here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1711 to 1714

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the east side of the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1711 to 1710

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a hut here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1711 to 1715

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a hut here.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1711 to 1716

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: West side of the Centaur Clearing

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a smallish hut, the home of a family of Centaurs.  The hut
is sparsely furnished, mostly the trappings of survival.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The opening leads out onto the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1712 to 1710

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Centaur's Hut

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a smallish hut, the home of a family of Centaurs.  The hut
is sparsely furnished, mostly the trappings of survival.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The opening leads out onto the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1713 to 1710

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Centaur's Hut

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a smallish hut, the home of a family of Centaurs.  The hut
is sparsely furnished, mostly the trappings of survival.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The opening leads out onto the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1714 to 1711

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Centaur's Hut

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are inside a smallish hut, the home of a family of Centaurs.  The hut
is sparsely furnished, mostly the trappings of survival.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The opening leads out onto the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1715 to 1711

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Centaur's Hut

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the entry foyer of a large hut.  A curtain separates this section
of the hut from the next section to the west.  To the east is an opening out
onto the clearing.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The opening leads out onto the clearing.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1716 to 1711

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a curtain here separating this section from the next.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1716 to 1717

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Entrance to a Large Hut

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in the back of a large hut.  A curtain separates this section from
the front of the hut to the east.  This room is finely decorated, if
somewhat primitive.  The decor suggests someone of authority lives here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: There is a curtain here separating this room from the front of the hut.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  1717 to 1716
